title_en: China's Ports (10/20): Piraeus, the Ancient Greek Port Where COSCO Bought In
note_en: Chinese often moves the object in front of the verb with 对 when the verb is a "dummy" like 进行 (carry out): 公司对港口的码头和设备进行了大规模升级和投资 "the company carried out large-scale upgrades of and investment in the port's terminals and equipment." The real action sits in the nouns after 进行 (升级, 投资), while 对 marks what the action is aimed at; compare 还对港池进行了疏浚 "and dredged the harbor basin," where English simply uses the verb "dredge."
